contracts.scope: Threshold arithmetic only: formula, positivity, endpoints, intermediate negative index and energy exponents. Not Theorem 4.1 or a PDE norm estimate.

The compact OpenAI packet: the Theorem 1.1 construction properties (not its nonexistence corollary) plus Lemma 2.2 and the zero extensions, for every ν>0; not the local insertion theorem and not any density statement.
the R³ content of Lemmas 3.4–3.5 for the inserted packet: correction field, force correction and their bounds; not Theorem 4.2's lifespan or density statements

Lemma B.1's gradient-L⁶ clause only; not the Ḣ^{1/2}/Ḣ^{3/2} embeddings. Stated for smooth fields with square-integrable Fréchet jets, the jet form of H^∞; its equivalence with the datum form Data.MemHInfty is not asserted.

Lemma A.1's H² ↪ L^∞ bounded-representative clause in jet form, whole space only (the torus half of lem:calculus is not stated); not the tame product estimates. Stated for smooth fields whose Fréchet jets of order at most 2 are square integrable, the jet form of H²; its equivalence with the datum form Data.MemHInfty is not asserted.

Proposition 3.3's transport of the rescaled packet (momentum equation at the same viscosity, incompressibility, unbounded speed at T) and the same-family scaling identities of Theorem 4.2's proof: the two E_T rates of eq:packetEscale, eq:wE and eq:REclose, eq:packetFscale, and the inhomogeneous L^q_t H^s_x bounds of eq:RpositiveScale and eq:RnegativeScale with the intermediate-index reduction and the force-convergence clause; not the homogeneous Hdot^s bounds (see HomogeneousScalingAPI) and not the insertion theorem

Lemma A.1's product clauses on the whole space, at the datum level of Contracts/V1/Data: eq:Rproduct's first clause for a scalar-scalar and a scalar-vector product at every integer order m >= 2, eq:algebra and eq:tame at every integer order k >= 3 with the low factor at order two, the u(x)u - v(x)v product difference bound (the manuscript states this one only qualitatively at appendix-a-local-theory.tex:51-52, so the registered inequality is derived from the factorization plus eq:algebra), and the H^m bound for the advection (u.grad)v; plus the two componentwise comparisons between the scalar and the three-vector norm and the admissibility instances for smooth fields with square-integrable jets. Not the embedding clauses (eq:Rproduct's L-infinity half is A03.bounded_representative, H^1 into L^6 and eq:embeddings are A05.gradient_l6), not the torus half of lem:calculus, not the order shift for the gradient, and no clause whose hypothesis is the datum form Data.MemHInfty: the advection clause is stated for the jet class, and two of the draft's four MemHInfty clauses (memHInfty_memHm and the MemHInfty advection bound), plus the exact componentwise norm identity, are collected unproved and unregistered in UnprovedTameProductObligations; the other two, memHInfty_component and memHInfty_partialDeriv, are one-step corollaries of memHInfty_memHm together with registered fields and are deliberately not restated there.

Theorem 4.2's inserted family and all its quantitative clauses except the maximal-lifespan identification and the reference-lifespan clause; the force-class membership g_eps in F_R and the ClassicalSolutionR fields sobolev/pressure_gradient for u_eps are not asserted, and the blow-up clause is registered in the pointwise SpeedUnboundedAt form, a deviation from the displayed limsup of the spatial sup norm that is equivalent for every inhabitant because the velocity slice is continuous
